name: s15-anth-repl-goal

tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"

runs.stdin:
!python -m pytest tests -q

/goal Make the test suite pass, then add a function `subtract(a, b)` to src/calc.py with a docstring and a test.
/side Which files has this session changed so far?
/recap
/goal
/exit
